title: Dichroic film
description: A thin translucent membrane rolls through olive, cobalt, and rose interference.
look: Glossy iridescent sphere banded with teal, magenta, olive and deep blue rings, a white softbox highlight and thin green rim on near-black.

title: Diffraction disc
description: A silver disc sends narrow spectral reflections across its fine concentric tracks.
look: Flat coral-red field with a centred silver compact disc whose fine concentric grooves carry radiating rainbow bands of cyan, green, magenta and pale blue.

title: Eclipse corona
description: A dark lunar disk reveals a fine white corona and a warm crescent.
look: Near-black field with a centred black lunar disc ringed by soft white radial corona streaks and a thin warm-gold crescent along its lower edge.

title: Edge etch
description: A stacked ceramic silhouette resolves into crisp extracted edges on ultramarine.
look: Saturated ultramarine field with a centred stack of four pebble-like ellipses drawn as thin white outlines, flat with no fill or shading.

title: Feedback echo
description: A precise luminous orbit leaves a retained echo that slowly stretches and fades.
look: Near-black teal field with one glowing teal elliptical ring crossed by a fine diagonal line, faint ghosted afterimages trailing inside it.

title: Flow memory
description: A metallic surface remembers the currents drawn across it as color and refraction.
look: Full-bleed silver-grey embossed leather texture with faint lime-green tinted swirls, above a dark green footer bar with a lime slider and outlined button.

title: Fluted prism
description: Sculptural color bends behind a sheet of ribbed architectural glass.
look: Off-white vertical fluted glass over a vermilion disc, a black disc and a diagonal cobalt bar, each sliced and offset by the ribs.

title: Prismatic relief
description: Raised ultramarine facets catch a moving light, revealing sharp ridges and shifting glints.
look: Near-black field with a rectangular six-by-four panel of cobalt pyramids with off-centre peaks, shaded deep navy to pale sky-blue highlights.

title: Frosted orbit
description: A satin glass disk softens the intersection of persimmon and plum.
look: Warm sand-beige ground with overlapping flat persimmon-orange and deep plum circles, and a frosted glass disc with a bright rim blurring their intersection.

title: Gravitational lens
description: A hovering lens bends a precise vermilion drafting grid.
look: Cream drafting paper with a fine vermilion square grid and one bold black diagonal band, magnified by a clear glass disc with a grey rim.

title: Guilloché
description: Fine engraved rosettes breathe inside a deep green edition print.
look: Deep emerald textured paper with a double hairline frame, a pale-green engraved rosette ring at right, monospace caps and a cream serif headline at left.

title: Gyroid cutaway
description: A saffron porous solid turns slowly, revealing continuous internal tunnels.
look: A softly lit saffron-orange porous cube of curving tunnels, rendered in 3D against a flat mid slate-grey background.

title: Halftone sculpture
description: A turning organic relief is translated into cobalt ink dots on uncoated paper.
look: Warm uncoated off-white paper with a cobalt-blue halftone dot blob, a heavy blue sans headline bottom-left, small spaced monospace labels and a serif numeral.

title: Heat signature
description: Heat moves through a soft-edged cross in violet, vermilion, and hot white.
look: Rounded plus-shaped mark tilted on a near-black violet field, glowing from deep violet through vermilion to a white-hot yellow core.

title: Highlight headroom
description: A blue-striped enamel loop compares controlled highlight compression with hard clipping under the same exposure.
look: White enamel ring with a cobalt stripe on near-black; a narrow right-hand clipping comparison and an exposure slider.

title: Ink current
description: Indigo ink stretches into fine branching currents on pale paper.
look: Full-bleed pale paper-grey field with large deep indigo ink pools, feathered edges and fine blue contour lines, like marbled paper.

title: Jacquard thread
description: Cobalt and unbleached threads cross in a visible twill with a burnt-orange stripe.
look: Full-bleed tilted twill weave of cobalt warp and unbleached cream weft threads, with evenly spaced burnt-orange warp stripes and fine fibre ridges.

title: Julia atlas
description: An intricate cyan fractal changes its connected islands as a complex parameter moves.
look: Pale icy-cyan lace-like fractal of spiral eyes and filigree islands, point-symmetric and centred on a near-black navy field.

title: Through the kiln
description: A twisting, fluted cobalt ceramic column opens along a light-blue cut face, revealing seven continuous internal channels.
look: A sculptural cobalt-blue extrusion with twisting flutes, an angled light-blue cut face, seven internal passages and a thin section control on warm stone white.

title: Lenticular grid
description: Black-and-white interlaced artwork flips through narrow red-edged ribs.
look: Full-bleed cream and near-black graphic of a sine wave and circle, sliced into narrow vertical ribs with thin red edges and cylindrical shading.

title: Light fibre
description: Fine amber fibres bend around one moving pulse of light.
look: Near-black field with a band of thirty-six fine amber-to-rust lines undulating across it, brightened by one soft golden highlight.

title: Liquid bridge
description: Two unequal ink-red lacquer drops form and release a smooth neck as their separation changes.
look: Two unequal dark-red glossy drops on a warm bone field, a crisp rectangular reflection and soft contact shadows.

title: Liquid chrome
description: A sculpted metal loop turns through hard studio highlights and one red reflection.
look: Near-black poster with a glossy chrome ring of black and silver bands with red reflections, heavy cream sans-serif title, monospace caption and red side label.

title: Lunar regolith
description: Raking light reveals a rough mineral moon against an icy white field.
look: A rough grey-brown pitted sphere with bump-shaded mineral texture, lit from the upper left and fading to black, centred on a pale icy blue-grey field.

title: Magnetic field
description: Fine white field lines bend between a pair of quiet cobalt poles.
look: Deep navy field with fine pale-blue curved field lines looping between a bright red-orange dot and a pale grey-white dot, flat and diagrammatic.

title: Metal emblem
description: An editable letter becomes a machined silver relief with directional highlights and a graphite surround.
look: Heavy bevelled silver letter with polished highlights and a soft shadow on dark graphite, with small grey header text and outlined input and button.

title: Mirror chamber
description: A folded white motif reflects into a changing peacock-blue radial composition.
look: Flat peacock-blue field with six cream petal shapes, each with a leaf-shaped cut-out, ringed around a thin orange star outline and orange dot.

title: Moiré weave
description: Two drifting line screens fold into an acid and violet optical weave.
look: Acid-lime and violet interference weave of fine diamond threads filling the frame, with a heavy lime sans-serif headline and monospace labels on violet blocks.

title: Noise threshold
description: Two bold primary-color prints exchange places through a continuous, seeded erosion field.
look: Flat primary-colour poster art: cobalt field with cream concentric rings and red stripes, broken by cloudy yellow patches with black shapes, above a cream slider.

title: Paper swarm
description: Printed sheets tumble through a deep blue volume in a single instanced draw call.
look: Saturated royal-blue field scattered with angled orange and pale-grey printed sheets showing dark headline blocks and text lines, plus a translucent slider bar.

title: Phosphor trace
description: A synthetic waveform sweeps across phosphor green gridwork with a restrained afterglow.
look: Near-black green CRT screen with a faint ruled grid, a glowing lime waveform with soft ghost trails, scanline texture, vignette and small monospace labels.

title: Pixel dissolve
description: A sculptural monogram breaks into a precise, staggered field of square pixels.
look: Pale sage-grey field with a large X monogram of small dark-green square pixels, partly dissolved, with vermilion pixels marking the dissolving edge.

title: Point cloud wave
description: An ultramarine point sheet rises into a calm three-dimensional swell.
look: Rows of small ultramarine dots form a wavy perspective sheet across the middle of a flat pale blue-grey field, leaving wide empty margins.

title: Porcelain candling
description: A warm backlight passes through an ivory vessel's thinner walls while the unlit side stays opaque.
look: An ivory open cup on warm black, localized amber transmitted light and an opaque unlit wall; a compact backlight slider below.

title: Engraved orbit
description: Fine silver engravings wrap a polished navy sphere, revealing its curvature as the object rotates in a pale studio.
look: Pale powder-blue studio with a glossy navy sphere wrapped in fine pale-silver contour lines, a soft floor shadow, and minimal navy controls.

title: Prism carousel
description: An architectural photo strip bends through a clear optical edge, then expands a selected image into an undistorted inspection view.
look: Light gray stage with a strip of architectural photos bent and stretched toward the edges with RGB fringing, an italic serif caption and arrow buttons.

title: Prismatic dispersion
description: A narrow white beam opens into a spectral fan through a glass wedge.
look: Black field with a translucent outlined glass triangle; a cream beam enters from the left and leaves as a soft rainbow fan to the right.

title: Reaction lab
description: Oxblood colonies divide into a living two-chemical pattern on a pale field.
look: Full-bleed two-tone pattern of deep oxblood ink and pale cream paper: rounded, soft-edged spots and branching worm shapes like Turing or coral markings.

title: Recursive aperture
description: Vermilion and ivory frames fold into a continuous recursive aperture.
look: Op-art tunnel of nested square frames with vermilion side and ivory top-and-bottom trapezoids, thick black bands between them, receding to a centre point.

title: Relief parallax
description: Ivory crosses rise above deep blue recesses and occlude each other as the view shifts.
look: Grid of pale ivory plus-shaped crosses raised over a deep navy ground, with soft grey shaded sides falling toward the lower right.

title: Ribbon gallery
description: A woodblock print separates into narrow, twisting ribbons before the next edition becomes whole.
look: Near-black gallery with a centred Japanese woodblock print, small spaced monospace labels, a cream serif title and two outlined circular arrow buttons.

title: Ripple memory
description: A silver-green water surface remembers each disturbance as overlapping waves.
look: Muted slate-teal liquid surface with glossy silver-green highlights and warped reflected vertical bands, distorted by overlapping ripple rings.

title: Riso overprint
description: Orange and burgundy inks drift through stochastic riso grain on warm uncoated paper and overprint into rust beneath a mark printed in both drums.
look: Warm cream paper with a grainy burgundy veil along the top, an orange swell beneath, and a heavy burgundy italic serif wordmark lower left.

title: Slipstream
description: Amber and oxblood air flows around a live headline, wrapping its first letter and riding the cap line.
look: Glowing orange, amber and deep red streaks flowing around a heavy cream sans-serif wordmark on a dark oxblood field.

title: Slit scan
description: A porcelain frame stretches into an impossible ribbon as each image column samples a different instant.
look: Thick porcelain-white rounded frame smeared into a warped, scalloped ribbon with a dark drop shadow on deep teal; a slim slider row below.

title: Sonic orb
description: A luminous blue membrane gathers fine contours while listening and emits expanding ripples while speaking.
look: Pale blue-grey page with a glossy cobalt sphere banded by wavy navy contours inside a blue halo, above three state buttons and a slider.

title: Storm volume
description: A dense cloud turns slowly beneath a cold silver rim.
look: A soft, wispy pale blue-grey cloud mass floating on a near-black slate-blue field, lit from the upper left with silvery highlights.

title: Tidal caustics
description: Sunlit turquoise water casts a drifting lattice on pale pool tiles.
look: Deep teal water filling the frame, crossed by glowing mint-cyan caustic light lines over faint dark pool-tile grid seams.

title: Truchet ribbon
description: Broad honey-colored ribbons join through a wine-red field of curved tiles.
look: Thick honey-yellow ribbons with a thin inset rust outline form interlocking rings and S-curves across a flat wine-red field.

title: Velvet dunes
description: Deep aubergine cloth catches a narrow silver-blue grazing light.
look: Full-bleed deep aubergine cloth with slanted folds, narrow lilac-silver highlights along the ridges and fine thread lines.

title: Wake image
description: A deep-blue sea photograph bends under short-lived wave fronts left by a moving pointer.
look: Full-bleed aerial photograph of turquoise surf breaking over rust-red rocks, with white letterspaced caps header, a white range slider and a translucent pill button.

title: Walnut cut
description: Warm walnut changes from end-grain rings to lengthwise growth as the cut turns.
look: Full-bleed warm orange-brown walnut surface with dark wavy concentric growth rings around an off-centre pith, fine vertical fibre streaks and pores.

title: After the rain
commonName: Paintable wet material and clearcoat shader
description: Water brushed across deep green stone accumulates into a glossy region, revealing a sharp grazing reflection beside the same dry material.
look: A large beveled mineral-green stone sample seen straight from above on dark green, thin light veins and subdued dark fractures; a brushed wet region catches a crisp white reflection with an irregular absorbent edge.

title: Wrap a mark
description: A cream geometric mark follows an unbranded cobalt canister as its surface placement changes and the vessel turns.
look: A matte cobalt canister with a quiet lid seam and cream geometric mark on warm stone; a red placement pin appears only during drag.
